fuse_conv_bn_layers: fuse a Conv2d layer with a following BatchNorm2d layer into a single convolution
fuse_module_recursively: recursively fuse all Conv2d and BatchNorm2d pairs in a PyTorch module tree
run_fuse_conv_bn_cli: run the CLI tool to fuse Conv and BN layers in an mmdet model checkpoint
review_fuse_conv_bn_math: review the fuse_conv_bn function and verify the weight and bias fusion math is correct
refactor_fuse_module_identity: refactor fuse_module to replace BatchNorm layers with nn.Identity after fusing with preceding Conv
